design.decisive_claim_binding: DC-10 'Developmental-lineage amortization across generations' (DECISIVE_CLAIM_REGISTRY_V1; atoms ATOM-DEV-01, ATOM-DEV-02; current_min 2)
design.scientific_question: Does earlier verified experience in ONE persistent lineage make later related cognition and later machine modification cheaper at matched capability and complete lifetime cost — measured on prospectively frozen related-task families with the full cost vector charged?
design.record_schema: DevelopmentTransitionV1 (#165 section G7): every transition records lineage id, source/target stage, machine identities, persistent-state digest, donor identities, prior-information manifest, new information, new methods/schemas, reused method identities, actual execution witnesses, primitive operators added, composition depth, acquisition/reasoning/verification/revision/self-change/maintenance cost, persistent bytes, active k/N, kappa/Omega/chi, retention, negative transfer, ablation, strongest-parent result, terminal
design.closure_plan_ref: research/top-tier-atomic-closure-v1/GATE_CLOSURE_PLAN.md (TTAC-D7b): for every open blocking-gate sub-item (G2.4 complete, G3.2 scoped failure memory, G3.3 representation change, G3.4 insufficiency-diagnosis loop, two-domain same core) the specific executable study, its registered scope and its owner lane — three of them are executions of already-frozen protocols (g2-length-scaling-v1, g3-scoped-failure-memory-v1 PROTOCOL.md + REPRESENTATION_PROTOCOL.md); none authorizes a flagship run

arms.rule: no reset across stages; full learned state persists where earned
same machine, state reset at each stage boundary
comparators evolve too; no frozen-parent strawman (#165 G7)

primary_endpoints: C_acquire(next related competence | K_t) vs C_acquire(next related competence | K_0)
C_reason(next related task) delta at matched capability
complete lifetime cost vector per DevelopmentTransitionV1
design.capability_gate: Performance_OCM >= Performance_parent - delta frozen BEFORE protected outcomes (#165 section 9); no efficiency claim if capability materially worse

stats_plan_frozen.design: paired across task-order permutations; fresh family identities; scale axis 1x/3x/10x/30x/100x where feasible (#165 section 10)
stats_plan_frozen.primary_test: pre-registered related-family acquisition-cost contrast, one-sided, frozen n, fixed horizon
stats_plan_frozen.multiplicity: Holm across the three primary endpoints
stats_plan_frozen.non_inferiority: capability margin delta frozen before protected splits
stats_plan_frozen.stopping_exclusion: no interim looks; exclusions only by pre-registered rules with reasons retained
stats_plan_frozen.independent_units: task families (not episodes); benchmark labels independently recovered, never generator intent (H-MV-05)

execution_hosts.forbidden: Mac mini — git/gh and single-file edits only

blocking_gates: G2 causal reuse complete in at least one domain
At least two materially different domains use the same core
authorization.rule: authorization flips only when every entry gate reads SATISFIED on an updated #165 evidence sync AND independently authored world families exist for E3 (H-MV-05); no partial-run waiver

entry_gates.gate: G2 causal reuse complete in at least one domain
